name: prooftrail
description: Supervisory review gate: sends the session's prompt and final output to a hosted review service for advisory feedback.

SERVICE_URL.title: Review service URL
SERVICE_URL.description: Origin of the review API (e.g. https://api.<your-domain>). Required — the plugin has no default.

API_TOKEN.title: Device token
API_TOKEN.description: Paired device token. Leave blank on the host (run /prooftrail:setup instead); set this only for sandbox surfaces, whose plugin data is wiped per session.
